name: Kuchum Khan
contribution: The last khan of Siberia, reigning from 1563 to 1598.

checks.lead: Kuchum Khan (Turki and Persian: کوچم خان, Siberian Tatar: Kütsem; Күцем, Russian: Кучум; 1527-c. 1605) was the last khan of Siberia, reigning from 1563 to 1598.
